_note: THE AUTHORED ATTACHMENT MAP - Stage 2 step 5.3, read by step 9.3's check.
It answers one question: which of THIS PROJECT'S documents is attached where. Control
Tower's own aws-guardrails-* documents are not here and must never be added - they are the
landing zone's objects, and a map that claimed them would invite an apply that fights it.
WHY IT IS AUTHORED AND NOT DISCOVERED. 1c attached four DIFFERENT documents to four OUs and
left three OUs carrying none, one of them - Sandboxes - deliberately (D37). A for_each over
the discovered OUs attaching 'the OU document' therefore has nothing to attach for three of
the seven and would attach something to Sandboxes, silently reversing a decision. An apply
that undoes a decision is worse than one that fails, so a document reaches an OU because
somebody wrote the pair down here.
WHY THE EMPTY OUs ARE LISTED RATHER THAN OMITTED. 'absent' and 'deliberately absent' have to
be distinguishable, or the check either fails forever or passes on a real gap (Lesson 13).
TARGETS ARE NAMES, NEVER IDS. No account id enters a tracked file (aws/INDEX.md rule 1), and
an OU id is resolved by the consumer: scripts/check-ou-coverage.sh through the Organizations
API, and step 5's slice through the same data-source walk. A document name is the file's own
basename in policies/, which is also the name the policy carries in Organizations.
ONE FILE, TWO CONSUMERS, ON PURPOSE (Lesson 14): the check and the Terraform for_each read
the same bytes, so the thing that is checked is the thing that is applied.

ou_with_no_document.Policy Test: D29 - the canary OU holds CANDIDATE documents under test and nothing standing. A document of this project's found attached here means a battery is in progress or was interrupted.
ou_with_no_document.Security: Foundational OU. It carries Control Tower's own guardrails by being foundational, and this project attaches nothing on top of them (1c step 7.6).
ou_with_no_document.Sandboxes: D37 - nested under Interactive and governed by inheritance. Nothing is attached here unless it DIFFERS from Interactive; sameness is inherited, never copied. This is the entry a future reader will try to 'fix'.
